decision: Reprimand (Driving) (This is the driver's 1st reprimand of the season)
event_name: Date 31 July 2021 Time 13:57 2021 HUNGARIAN GRAND PRIX 29 July - 1 August 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 21 & 22) and heard from the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 31.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Reprimand (Driving) (This is the driver's 1st reprimand of the season)
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 99 (Antonio Giovinazzi), the driver of car 10 (Pierre Gasly) and team representatives and reviewed video evidence. During FP3 GAS was on a quick lap, while GIO was on an out lap, driving slowly on the line at the exit of T13 in front of GAS. GIO had no warning by his team and admitted during the hearing that he impeded GAS. Both drivers agreed to the Steward's opinion that this is not acceptable during free practice.
rules_referenced: Article 31.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 99 Impeding Car 10
